1	"""Static, fail-closed gate for the reviewed flat CTest registry. Never runs CMake.
     2	
     3	This is deliberately not a general CMake interpreter. Only literal generated
     4	add_test/set_tests_properties declarations are supported. Includes, subdirectories,
     5	hooks, control flow and new generator formats require a separate policy review.
     6	"""
     7	import hashlib
     8	import os
     9	from pathlib import Path
    10	import re
    11	import stat
    12	
    13	from cpu_gpu_protocol import ROOT, require
    14	
    15	HOOK_NAMES = {'CTestCustom.cmake', 'CTestCustom.ctest', 'CTestConfig.cmake'}
    16	TOKEN = re.compile(r'"([^"\\\r\n]*)"|\[=\[([^\r\n]*?)\]=\]|([A-Za-z0-9_]+)')
    17	
    18	
    19	def read_regular(path):
    20	    """Reject symlinks/nonregular/unreadable files rather than interpreting them."""
    21	    info = path.lstat()
    22	    require(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and bool(info.st_mode & 0o444),
    23	            'unreadable/nonregular build metadata: ' + str(path))
    24	    require(info.st_size <= 1024*1024, 'oversized build metadata')
    25	    raw = path.read_bytes()
    26	    text = raw.decode('utf-8', errors='strict')
    27	    require(not any(c in text for c in ['\x00', '\r', '${', '$ENV{', '$<']),
    28	            'ambiguous/expanded build metadata: ' + str(path))
    29	    return text, hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

    32	def statements(text):
    33	    """Accept the small literal grammar emitted by the reviewed generators."""
    34	    result = []
    35	    for line in text.splitlines():
    36	        line = line.strip()
    37	        if not line:
    38	            continue
    39	        if line.startswith('#'):
    40	            require(not line.startswith('#['), 'unreviewed bracket comment')
    41	            continue
    42	        match = re.fullmatch(r'(add_test|set_tests_properties)\((.*)\)', line)
    43	        require(match is not None, 'unreviewed CTest statement (includes/subdirs/hooks forbidden)')
    44	        tokens, cursor = [], 0
    45	        arguments = match[2]
    46	        while cursor < len(arguments):
    47	            if arguments[cursor].isspace():
    48	                cursor += 1
    49	                continue
    50	            token = TOKEN.match(arguments, cursor)
    51	            require(token is not None, 'malformed/ambiguous CTest argument')
    52	            tokens.append(next(group for group in token.groups() if group is not None))
    53	            cursor = token.end()
    54	            require(cursor == len(arguments) or arguments[cursor].isspace(),
    55	                    'ambiguous adjacent CTest arguments')
    56	        result.append((match[1], tokens))
    57	    return result

    60	def expand(value, build):
    61	    return value.replace('@source', str(ROOT.resolve())).replace('@build', str(build))

    64	def validate_dart(path, build, policy):
    65	    # DartConfiguration is key/value data, not CMake. Do not evaluate it. These
    66	    # reviewed dashboard commands are not invoked by our fixed -N/-R commands.
    67	    require(stat.S_ISREG(path.lstat().st_mode) and bool(path.stat().st_mode & 0o444),
    68	            'unreadable/nonregular Dart configuration')
    69	    require(path.stat().st_size <= 1024*1024, 'oversized Dart configuration')
    70	    raw = path.read_bytes()
    71	    values = {}
    72	    for line in raw.decode('utf-8', errors='strict').splitlines():
    73	        if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
    74	            continue
    75	        require(re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*: [^\x00\r\n]*', line) is not None,
    76	                'malformed Dart configuration')
    77	        key, value = line.split(': ', 1)
    78	        require(key not in values, 'duplicate Dart setting')
    79	        values[key] = value
    80	    expected = policy['dart_defaults']
    81	    require(set(values) == set(expected), 'unknown/missing Dart setting')
    82	    for key, value in values.items():
    83	        if key in policy['dart_inert_metadata']:
    84	            # These values are output-only environment labels, never commands.
    85	            require(not any(c in value for c in [';', '$', '\\', '"']), 'ambiguous Dart label')
    86	        elif key in ['ConfigureCommand', 'MakeCommand']:
    87	            # Only an absolute cmake executable and the exact reviewed arguments.
    88	            pattern = (r'"/[^";\s]+/cmake" "' + re.escape(str(ROOT.resolve())) + r'"'
    89	                       if key == 'ConfigureCommand' else
    90	                       r'/[^";\s]+/cmake --build \. --config "\$\{CTEST_CONFIGURATION_TYPE\}"')
    91	            require(re.fullmatch(pattern, value) is not None, 'unreviewed Dart command: ' + key)
    92	        elif key == 'DefaultCTestConfigurationType':
    93	            require(value in ['Release', 'Debug'], 'unreviewed build configuration')
    94	        else:
    95	            require(value == expand(expected[key], build), 'modified Dart setting: ' + key)
    96	    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

    99	def validate_build_tree(build_dir, manifest, expected_command):
   100	    """Return a fingerprint only after all reachable CTest metadata is classified.
   101	
   102	    The project registers all tests at the root. Reject nested test files and all
   103	    includes/subdirs instead of attempting to evaluate arbitrary CMake programs.
   104	    Scan the whole tree for directory hooks, including unreachable nested hooks.
   105	    """
   106	    build = Path(build_dir).absolute()
   107	    require(build == build.resolve() and build.is_dir(), 'missing/aliased build directory')
   108	    for component in [build, *build.parents]:
   109	        require(not component.is_symlink(), 'symlinked build directory')
   110	    require(not any(k.startswith('CTEST_') for k in os.environ), 'unreviewed CTEST environment override')
   111	    policy = manifest.get('build_metadata')
   112	    require(isinstance(policy, dict) and policy.get('policy') == 'flat_literal_ctest_v1',
   113	            'missing reviewed build-metadata policy')
   114	    files = {}
   115	    def onerror(error):
   116	        raise ValueError('unreadable build tree: ' + str(error)) from error
   117	    for directory, dirs, names in os.walk(build, followlinks=False, onerror=onerror):
   118	        parent = Path(directory)
   119	        require(bool(parent.stat().st_mode & 0o444) and bool(parent.stat().st_mode & 0o111),
   120	                'unreadable build directory')
   121	        for name in dirs + names:
   122	            path = parent/name
   123	            require(not path.is_symlink(), 'unreviewed build symlink: ' + str(path))
   124	            require(name not in HOOK_NAMES and not name.endswith('.ctest'),
   125	                    'unreviewed CTest hook/configuration: ' + str(path))
   126	            if name in ['CTestTestfile.cmake', 'DartConfiguration.tcl']:
   127	                require(parent == build and name in names, 'unreviewed nested CTest metadata: ' + str(path))
   128	    testfile = build/'CTestTestfile.cmake'
   129	    text, digest = read_regular(testfile)
   130	    files['CTestTestfile.cmake'] = digest
   131	    declarations, properties = {}, {}
   132	    for command, args in statements(text):
   133	        require(bool(args), 'empty CTest declaration')
   134	        name = args[0]
   135	        require(name in manifest['tests'], 'unreviewed CTest test name')
   136	        if command == 'add_test':
   137	            require(name not in declarations and name not in properties, 'duplicate/out-of-order CTest declaration')
   138	            require([str(Path(a).resolve()) for a in args[1:]] == expected_command(manifest['tests'][name]['command'], build),
   139	                    'unreviewed generated command: ' + name)
   140	            declarations[name] = args[1:]
   141	        else:
   142	            require(name in declarations and name not in properties and len(args) >= 4 and args[1] == 'PROPERTIES'
   143	                    and len(args) % 2 == 0, 'malformed/duplicate CTest properties')
   144	            pairs = dict(zip(args[2::2], args[3::2]))
   145	            require(len(pairs) == (len(args)-2)//2, 'duplicate CTest property')
   146	            expected = policy['test_properties'].get(name)
   147	            require(isinstance(expected, dict) and pairs == {k: expand(v, build) for k,v in expected.items()},
   148	                    'unreviewed generated properties/hooks/fixtures: ' + name)
   149	            properties[name] = pairs
   150	    names = set(declarations)
   151	    cpu = set(manifest['cpu_build_tests']); gpu = set(manifest['cuda_additional_tests'])
   152	    require(names in [cpu, cpu | gpu] and set(properties) == names, 'incomplete/unreviewed generated registry')
   153	    dart = build/'DartConfiguration.tcl'
   154	    if dart.exists():
   155	        files[dart.name] = validate_dart(dart, build, policy)
   156	    return dict(policy=policy['policy'], build_dir=str(build), files_sha256=files,
   157	                test_names=sorted(names), commands=declarations, properties=properties)
